title: QUIC RFC 9000 S17P4 Spin Bit Per-Path State
purpose: Describe the focused S17P4 closure for per-path spin-bit storage, received packet-number gating, and 1-RTT short-header emission.
design_summary: Each runtime path record carries a spin-bit state containing the stored spin value and the highest received 1-RTT packet number that affected it. The 1-RTT receive path updates that state only when the packet number advances for the path, with servers storing the received bit and clients storing its inverse. All runtime 1-RTT emission seams pass the path's stored value into short-header packet construction.
data_and_state_considerations: The spin-bit state is path-local and moves with active, candidate, and recently validated path records. The short-header builder still applies the randomized one-in-sixteen connection-ID disablement floor before setting the wire bit, so path state cannot override disabled spin-bit selection.
edge_cases_and_constraints: Zero-length connection IDs remain in the disabled randomized-selection bucket.
Client spin updates ignore non-increasing packet numbers for the path.
Connection-close, recovery probe, ordinary application send, path-directed send, and retransmission paths all use the stored path value.
The slice does not alter long-header packet handling because the spin bit is a 1-RTT short-header signal.
risks: This slice does not claim a public spin-bit administration API beyond the existing runtime configuration seam.
This slice does not claim observer RTT estimation completeness.
This slice does not close deferred fuzz obligations for S17P4.
This slice does not claim hosted interop readiness.

supplemental_sections.heading: Boundary
supplemental_sections.content: This design closes the focused generated S17P4 per-path spin-bit proof set: REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S17P4-0008, RFC9000-S17-4-P7-R01, and RFC9000-S17-4-P8-S1-R01, plus the missing RFC9000-S17-4-P4-S2-R01 edge proof. It does not claim broader spin-bit privacy policy, public API widening, hosted interop readiness, or closure of deferred fuzz obligations.
